name: Crash Derby
hook: Ram, dent and wreck them. Last car running wins.
how: Everyone drives into one dirt bowl. Ram the other cars, side hits do the most damage, and boost in for a big one. Dents, smoke and loose parts show who is hurting; the last car still running wins.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to drive, Shift or Space to boost, or on-screen buttons
uses: The best derby scores: damage dealt, wrecks and wins.
The host's browser starts and ends each round; if it leaves, the next player takes over.
Bots ram and dodge until enough people join.
Every car drives for everyone at once, and the car that gets hit works out its own damage.
ideas: Add a ramp in the middle of the bowl
Add a repair pickup that heals 30 health
Make it a snowy ice rink where cars slide more
